# Resource: tfe_hyok_configuration

Manages a HYOK configuration.

~> **Note:** This resource requires using the provider with HCP Terraform on the HCP Terraform Premium edition. Refer to [HCP Terraform pricing](https://www.hashicorp.com/en/pricing?product_intent=terraform&tab=terraform) for details.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    const tfeGcpOidcConfigurationGcp =
      new tfe.gcpOidcConfiguration.GcpOidcConfiguration(this, "gcp", {
        organization: "my-org-name",
        projectNumber: "11111111",
        serviceAccountEmail: "myemail@gmail.com",
        workloadProviderName:
          "projects/1/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/1/providers/1",
      });
    new tfe.hyokConfiguration.HyokConfiguration(this, "example", {
      agentPoolId: "apool-MFtsuFxHkC9pCRgB",
      kekId: "key1",
      kmsOptions: [
        {
          keyLocation: "global",
          keyRingId: "example-key-ring",
        },
      ],
      name: "my-key-name",
      oidcConfigurationId: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeGcpOidcConfigurationGcp.id),
      oidcConfigurationType: "gcp",
      organization: "my-hyok-org",
    });
  }
}

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agentPoolId` (String) The ID of the agent-pool to associate with the HYOK configuration.
- `kekId` (String) Refers to the name of your key encryption key stored in your key management service.
- `name` (String) Label for the HYOK configuration to be used within HCP Terraform.
- `oidcConfigurationId` (String) The ID of the TFE OIDC configuration. This is typically sourced from another OIDC configuration resource corresponding with the target cloud provider, such as `tfeOidcConfigurationGcp`, `tfeOidcConfigurationAws`, or `tfeOidcConfigurationAzure`.
- `oidcConfigurationType` (String) The type of the TFE OIDC configuration. Valid values are `vault`, `aws`, `gcp`, and `azure`.

### Optional

- `kmsOptions` (Block, Optional) Optional object used to specify additional fields for some key management services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kms_options))
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the HYOK configuration.

<a id="nestedblock--kms_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kmsOptions`

Optional:

- `keyLocation` (String) The location in which the GCP key ring exists.
- `keyRegion` (String) The AWS region where your key is located.
- `keyRingId` (String) The root resource for Google Cloud KMS keys and key versions.




## Import

Resource tfe_hyok_configuration can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <HYOK ID>
terraform import tfe_hyok_configuration.gcp_example hyokc-XqYizSPQmeiG1aHJ
```
